description: Oscillator, 3HP — one waveform at a time

params.text: Sets the pitch, -3 to +6 volts; 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz
Drops the whole pitch range by seven octaves, so the module runs as an LFO
Sine, triangle, saw, square, or 25% or 10% pulse
How deeply the FM jack modulates the frequency, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the polyphony
A CV modulating the frequency at the depth set by the FM knob; exponential, or linear through-zero if that is chosen on the menu
A rising edge hard-syncs the oscillator, restarting its cycle

menu: FM mode — the FM input modulates Exponential or Linear, through zero
Linear frequency mode — the frequency follows the pitch voltage at a fixed number of hertz per volt rather than an octave per volt
Reset phase on wave change — picking a different wave restarts it at phase zero rather than carrying on from where the old one had reached
Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, V/OCT input or FM input
DC offset correction — on by default, removes the offset the square and pulse waves carry away from a 50% width; turn it off to use such an output as a CV
